subject: Operations
title: Modes of Transportation
description: A quick win: understand Modes of Transportation.

hook.text: A banana travels by truck, ship, and refrigerated rail to reach your grocery store. Each leg has a different mode.

buildup.text: The five modes are truck, rail, ship, air, and pipeline. Each trades off speed, cost, and capacity.

discovery.text: Trucks are flexible but expensive per mile. Ships are cheap but slow. Air is fast but costly. Rail handles bulk.

twist.text: Most freight uses intermodal transport—combining modes for the best tradeoff of cost and speed.

climax.text: A container might travel by ship from China, rail across the US, and truck to a local store. Three modes, one journey.

punchline.text: No single mode wins. The best supply chains blend them.
